title: Canonical exchange squares for normalized families
statement: Every family c,b,d satisfying SpP1NormalizedDecompositions for a finite commutative ring A annihilated by positive N [def-sp-p1-proetale-trace-system] satisfies SpP1BaseChange. This is exactly the canonical untwisted decomposition square and the inverse-twisted-splitting trace square, for every morphism of N-invertible schemes, with no Noetherian condition.

source.place: Proof paragraphs 1--2: both canonical arbitrary-base-change equations

proof.text: The normalized Chern arrow pulls back to the normalized Chern arrow on the new base, by Kummer naturality and injectivity of the normalized class comparison.
The unit mate and tensor-Chern adjunct give the two components of the ordinary decomposition exchange square. Normalized twist evaluation and exchange/tensor coherence preserve their signs and order.

Apply exact comparison and the counit-normalized coefficient exchange identity. Taking mates of the pullback square yields the specified pro-etale square, for both the untwisted and positive shifted line.
Biproduct extensionality gives the untwisted equation. Cancel the pulled-back twisted isomorphism in its square and project to the constant second summand to obtain exactly the trace equation.

theorem spP1BaseChange_of_normalized (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (c : SpP1ChernFamily A N hA) (b : SpP1TwistedFamily A N hA)
    (d : SpP1DecompositionFamily A N hA)
    (hnorm : SpP1NormalizedDecompositions A N hN hA c b d) :
    SpP1BaseChange A N hN hA b d
